title: Dominated-convergence limit of the rescaled chart integral (rⁿ)⁻¹∫_Ω J(v)φ(r⁻¹(Φ(v) − Φ(w))) dv
statement:
Let Q, n ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q continuous, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open and w ∈ Ω. Assume Φ is differentiable at w with derivative L := DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w, and that there is c > 0 with c|v − v′| ≤ |Φ(v) − Φ(v′)| for all v, v′ ∈ Ω. Let J : ℝⁿ → ℝ be continuous and φ : ℝ^Q → ℝ continuous with compact support. Then, as r → 0⁺ (filter 𝓝[>] 0),
(rⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_Ω J(v) φ(r⁻¹(Φ(v) − Φ(w))) dLⁿ(v) → ∫_{ℝⁿ} J(w) φ(L s) dLⁿ(s).
Here Lⁿ = volume on ℝⁿ and all integrals are Bochner integrals.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (J : Eucl n → ℝ) (φ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (w : Eucl n), IsOpen Ω → w ∈ Ω → Continuous Φ → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ Ω, ∀ v' ∈ Ω, c * ‖v - v'‖ ≤ ‖Φ v - Φ v'‖) → Continuous J → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ v in Ω, J v * φ (r⁻¹ • (Φ v - Φ w))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ s, J w * φ (fderiv ℝ Φ w s)))
